description_en: Modifies the parameters of a single node and applies them to the specified node
description_zh: 修改单个节点的参数并应用到指定节点
name: ModifyDBNodesParameters

parameters.help_en: The node IDs. You can specify multiple node IDs separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 节点ID。支持传入多个节点ID，多个节点ID间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_node_ids

parameters.help_en: The JSON string of parameters and their values. Note: For the list of parameters (where IsNodeAvailable is 1 and IsModifiable is true) and the valid values of the CheckingCode parameter for each parameter, see the relevant documentation. Only node-level parameters (parameters whose IsNodeAvailable is 1 in the response of DescribeDBNodesParameters) are supported. To modify cluster-level parameters, call ModifyDBClusterParameters
parameters.help_zh: 参数及参数值的JSON串。调用说明：参数列表（IsNodeAvailable=1 且 IsModifiable=true 的参数）及各参数的 CheckingCode 取值范围。调用说明：仅支持节点级参数（通过 DescribeDBNodesParameters 返回中 IsNodeAvailable 为 1 的参数），集群级参数请通过 ModifyDBClusterParameters 修改
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: The earliest time to execute the scheduled kernel version upgrade task (that is, execute within the target time period). The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 开始执行定时（即在目标时间段内执行）内核版本升级任务的最早时间。格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ（UTC）
parameters.name: planned_start_time

parameters.help_en: The latest time to start the scheduled task. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 开始执行目标定时任务的最晚时间。格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ（UTC）
parameters.name: planned_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to immediately execute or schedule the parameter modification and restart. Valid values:
false: schedules the task. This is the default value.
true: immediately executes the task
parameters.help_zh: 立即执行或定时执行修改参数并重启取值：  false（默认值）：定时执行 true：立即执行
parameters.name: from_time_service
